summary: Introducing our latest additions to the Studio Bagno bathware collection!
title: New Products Showcase March 2019
bodyHtml:
Verve Solid Surface Bath

The composite material of our latest collection is delightfully smooth, warming quickly for a luxurious bathing experience.

Our stocked colours Matte White and Ash Grey (at an additional cost). Material samples will be available at select retail outlets or by request from our office.

The inert non-toxic composite is homogenous ensuring ease of cleaning and long term maintenance. UV resistant.

Our new collection of mirrors are easy to install and feature crisp, solid surface walls of tactile matte white.

Design simplicity means that you can pair them with a large range of basins, baths and vanities for a complete contemporary aesthetic.
